items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And Bobby Hackett was saying, "I don't see how you do it."

ctx.x: And Bobby Hackett was saying, "I don't see how you do it." And I said, "Well, you shouldn't." He says, "After two shows I'm through." And I said, "Well, they shouldn't make you play with a mute, soft as you play."
